story.title: Destiny Brought Them Together
story.text: What began with family introductions and heartfelt conversations soon grew into deep respect, gentle laughter, and a profound mutual understanding.

story.title: Two Families, One Sacred Harmony
story.text: With the heartfelt love and sacred blessings of the Arora and Tuteja families, two worlds aligned in lifelong kinship and devotion.

story.title: Now Love Will Seal Their Bond
story.text: Surrounded by the warmth of elders, family, and lifelong friends, Sahil and Kajal take their sacred seven vows for a lifetime of togetherness.
